## INTERPRETATION
  FlushGearComposite calls 0x4F2CE0 for +0x1A4 and +0x1B0 face mips.
  Uses [esi+0x34] as pool: cmp [edi+0x34], 0x28 — max 40 pool slots?
  Stores result into [edi+0x34+slot*4] array at offset 0x38.
  Gear-only dirty (bits 0-7) still triggers face mip pool rotation.
  Face repaste on +0x1A4 may not match displayed pool slot after swap.
